text: dsh-session-title-summary 是面向 DSH 的会话管理插件，适用于 Web 和 TUI。它监听顶层 agent 每轮结束事件，整理用户消息、助手回复和工具调用，再让子代理更新滚动式会话摘要与当前任务标题。摘要按会话保存到 DSH_HOME 下，标题通过 DSH 会话标题服务更新；可设置开关、标题长度和子代理超时，并可选指定模型路由。适合希望自动追踪长会话目标与当前事项的 DSH 用户。

dsh-session-title-summary is a DSH session plugin for Web and TUI. After each top-level turn, it summarizes new messages and tool activity, updates a rolling outline, and renames the session for its current task. Summaries are stored under DSH_HOME; title length and timeout are configurable.

DSH 会话太长，怎样保留旧目标并突出当前工作？
希望每次对话完成后自动重命名会话
Keep a rolling outline of a coding session and its current task
Automatically update a session title after each completed turn
dsh-session-title-summary 的功能「turn-summary」：每轮结束后，插件读取上次摘要之后的新会话事件，提取用户、助手和工具活动并交给子代理折叠更新；摘要保留在会话级大纲中。
dsh-session-title-summary 的功能「title-update」：子代理依据更新后的摘要生成当前任务标题；插件按显示宽度截短标题，再通过 DSH 标题服务重命名顶层会话。
dsh-session-title-summary 的功能「local-storage」：插件为每个会话保存版本化 JSON 摘要与已处理事件序号，写入临时文件后重命名完成原子更新。
dsh-session-title-summary 的功能「settings」：用户可关闭自动处理、调整标题长度目标、设置子代理超时，并可选指定 provider 和 model；默认沿用当前会话路由。
dsh-session-title-summary 会把每个会话的滚动摘要写入 DSH_HOME 下的本地 JSON 文件；会话原始消息摘要交给子代理处理。
dsh-session-title-summary 只管理顶层会话；来源为 subagent 或带父会话标记的会话会被跳过。

A host-only plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): after every completed turn it
summarizes the session's work in a **rolling "major topic - minor topic"
outline** and renames the session to a title that names the session GOAL and
the specific item being handled right now. Implemented entirely through the
official NPM SDK — no DSH source changes.
section: dsh-session-title-summary — Rolling session summary + task title

text:
@xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary README · How it works：- The plugin listens for `agent/turn-stopping` (the same event dsh-auto-memory
  uses) on every live top-level agent.
- After the turn settles, it spawns a **subagent** with the live agent as the
  parent, so the child inherits the same model route and workspace and the main
  conversation is never blocked or polluted.
- The subagent receives the previous rolling summary plus a digest of the new
  events (user prompts, assistant replies, tool calls with names/arguments/
  results) and returns an updated summary and a new title as a structured
  object.
- The summary is stored atomically per session under
  `$DSH_HOME/dsh-session-title-summary/<sessionId>.json` and the session is
  renamed via the official `sessionTitle` service.

@xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary README · Cache safety：The `session/title` event is log-only: it never enters `deriveMessages()`, the
system prompt, tool schemas, or the request prefix, so renaming does not touch
the input cache hit rate or the KV cache. Summarization runs in a detached
subagent with its own prompt — it shares no prefix with the main conversation.
@xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary README · Install：```sh
@xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary README · From npm (when published)：dsh plugin --profile <name> add @xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary@latest

@xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary README · From the repository (development)：git clone <this repo>
cd xiaochaz-session-title-summary
pnpm install && pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:$(pwd)
```

After installing, **restart `dsh web`**. The plugin takes effect on the next
completed turn.

@xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. Turn it off to keep session titles untouched (the plugin then does nothing). |
| `targetWords` | `6` | Prompt target for non-CJK title length (words); the enforced cap is display width. |
| `targetCjkCharacters` | `10` | Enforced title width cap in CJK characters (2 ASCII/half-width chars = 1 CJK). |
| `provider` / `model` | session route | Optional explicit LLM route override; default follows the session's current model. |
| `timeoutMs` | `90000` | Per-fold subagent timeout. |

@xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary README · Data：- Rolling summaries: `$DSH_HOME/dsh-session-title-summary/<sessionId>.json`
  (versioned JSON, atomic write; `lastSeq` is the highest folded event seq).

@xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

@xiaochaz/dsh-session-title-summary README · Known limitations：- The summarizer subagent has a fixed 8192-token output budget and the
  summary itself is bounded to 1000 characters; if a fold still fails, the
  cursor advances without renaming, so the same events are not re-fed forever.
- Explicitly user-renamed sessions are re-titled by the plugin on the next
  turn while enabled (turn the switch off to stop that).
- Subagent child sessions are skipped; only their parent's title is managed.
